evidence.quote: Placental samples were collected by the physician at birth, frozen at -80 °C within 15 min
The V3–V4 regions of the 16 S rRNA gene were amplified
Potential contamination was monitored during laboratory processing using negative extraction controls and no-template PCR controls.

notes: Fecal and placental samples from 20 pregnant women; only placenta extracted. Ralstonia dominant (~85-89%), a classic reagent contaminant, but not interpreted as such. Controls 'monitored', sequencing of controls not stated. Lactobacillus LEfSe result (E0029) refers to gut samples, not recorded. top5 left empty: text gives group-wise abundances, not an explicit ranking (Ralstonia > Stenotrophomonas > Delftia appear top 3).
